intro: Deliveries to Sven is an Alliance task given by Elaine Carevin in Darkshire, requesting that vital provisions be carried out to a lonely camp on the northwest frontier of Duskwood. There, Sven Yorgen and his few remaining followers wage a desperate, solitary struggle against the horrors of the blighted woods. The errand connects town folk struggling in the gloom with an isolated band on the edge of the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.
Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look a sturdy type, adventurer. Have you come to join our fight?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
